title: Render Jobs Analytics with PySpark
subtitle: Distributed Micro-ETL Pipeline & Jupyter Notebook
summary: PySpark and SQLite ETL pipeline consolidating video rendering jobs, scripts, and segments, interactively analyzed in Jupyter Notebook.
overview: Data engineering Proof of Concept validating PySpark for unifying and performing exploratory analytics on relational tables containing video rendering job metrics.
responsibilities: Developed PySpark ETL script for data extraction, transformation, and loading.
Optimized SQL queries with multiple LEFT JOINs ensuring 1:N integrity between scripts and video segments.
Materialized DataFrames in Jupyter Notebook for interactive analytics.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Consolidating fragmented rendering data from SQLite while ensuring future Data Lake scalability.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Utilized PySpark DataFrames allowing identical transformation logic to process large-scale data in production.

metrics: Validated ETL pipeline ready for Data Lake scaling
